name: @sabbour/squadboard-monorepo
description: Pre-alpha local-first kanban + workflow board for Squad agents

scripts.npm:build: pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard-cli run build && pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard run build
scripts.npm:publish:dry-run: pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard-sdk publish --dry-run --no-git-checks --access public --tag prealpha && pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard-cli publish --dry-run --no-git-checks --access public --tag prealpha && pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard publish --dry-run --no-git-checks --access public --tag prealpha
